products.name: Configurable robust packing table
products.summary: Robust packing table with a frame of 40 × 40 mm aluminium profiles, made to your size. Set the dimensions, shelves and accessories and see the result in 3D.
products.description:
Frame from 40 × 40 mm profiles
The frame of this table is made of aluminium profiles with a 40 × 40 mm cross-section and a 10 mm slot, joined with corner connectors. It is the largest of our three frame sizes; the other tables have 30 × 30 mm and 35 × 35 mm profiles.

Your own dimensions
You choose the worktop width, depth and height. The width can be 500 to 3000 mm and the depth 400 to 1500 mm. Above 1500 mm of width the table gets an additional middle leg at the front and at the back.

Shelves and accessories
You can add lower shelves (up to 10, depending on the height of the table) and choose castors, perforated tool panels, LED lighting, steel drawers, a power strip with sockets and a holder for a PET bottle. Cut-outs in the worktop can be added as well.

Every combination is checked
When you change something, the frame is recalculated. A combination that cannot be made is refused and the reason is shown.

Delivery, assembly and shipping
The table is made to order and delivery takes 3–5 weeks. Assembly is an optional service: with it the table is delivered assembled, without it disassembled, and you assemble it yourself. The shipping price depends on whether you choose assembly; we set it after the order and confirm it with you before the proforma invoice is issued.
